subject.title: feat(dashboard): pinned MCP apps — board rendering, lease re-mint, durable tool grants

question: Should a granted pinned MCP App be allowed to retain any mutable model-context authority after its board widget is removed, replaced, or revoked, or must every such operation obey the same live grant check as tool calls?
rationale: The PR’s stated security model is revision-bound durable grants, but deciding whether model-context mutation is included in that boundary affects the permanent MCP App authorization contract.

options.title: Apply live grant checks everywhere
options.body: Require the same live revision/grant/generation authorization callback for tool calls and model-context updates before merge.

options.title: Treat model context as separate authority
options.body: Document and explicitly approve continued model-context updates from a retained view lease after widget revocation.

recommendation.title: Apply live grant checks everywhere
recommendation.body: Require the same live revision/grant/generation authorization callback for tool calls and model-context updates before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned contributor owns the proposed board/MCP authorization design on this branch.
